items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: This car had "Wendy" written on the back of it.

ctx.x: speed limit on the Turnpike then was 65, and I think I was doing about 50, which I think was kind of fast in that kind of weather, but there were a lot of other cars which were driving much faster. It was really one of those downpours, with the thunder and lightning and everything. So I think I'm driving at a moderate speed, the speed limit being 65, and all of a sudden, this car zoomed past me, and all I could see was on the back of it... It was the kind of car that back in those days they called hot rods, that…

Anyway, he passed me, and he meant to make a turn to get into the right lane in front of me. And when he did, he must have turned the car too quickly or something, because the car skidded and headed towards this embankment. Well, the Pennsylvania Turnpike is really a mountain... I think there's hills and mountains all the way on it. And there's nothing but a guard rail over there, sometimes that keeps you from falling 50 or 60 feet down. So he's heading towards this guard rail, then he panics and he turns it the…
